prompt_en: An extremely rough, messy, dirty pencil storyboard sheet. Scribbled thumbnail sketches that look like they were drawn in 10 seconds, rough gesture sketches, loose scratchy lines, barely readable shapes. Complete doodle-level roughness, even messier and rougher than a clean sketch. Aspect ratio: 21:9. Black and white only. Absolutely do not make it look like a finished drawing. Do not make clean line art. Arrange exactly 12 panels in a 4×3 grid, 4 columns by 3 rows. Each panel should have a messy, uneven rectangular frame that looks quickly drawn. No text, numbers, logos, or captions at all. A scene of a woman making and drinking pour over coffee. Consistency rules: keep everything physically correct across all panels. The pour over dripper must always be the same cone-shaped dripper sitting on top of the same glass server. Always draw it from the same diagonal front angle. Do not flip the orientation. The kettle must always be the same long-spouted gooseneck kettle. The spout must always point in the same direction. Keep the hands simple. Draw a maximum of two fingers. Do not draw extra fingers or broken joints. The coffee grounds must always appear as a dark rough layer inside the filter. Do not make it look like liquid until water is added. Panel 1 (hook): Whole coffee beans poured into a hand grinder from above. Beans scatter and bounce dramatically. Panel 2: The grinder handle being turned. Coffee dust and aroma lines rising. Panel 3: The ground coffee poured from the grinder into a paper filter inside the cone dripper. Grounds settle into a flat bed. Panel 4: The gooseneck kettle lifted. A thin precise stream of hot water poured in a slow spiral over the grounds. Bloom forming grounds puff up. Panel 5: Close-up of the blooming coffee grounds. CO2 bubbles rising from the wet surface. Steam rising. Panel 6: A second steady pour begins. Water spiraling outward from center. Coffee beginning to drip into the glass server below. Panel 7: The glass server filling slowly with dark coffee. Crema layer visible at the top of the liquid. Panel 8: The dripper lifted off and set aside. The finished coffee in the glass server, steam rising. Panel 9: Coffee poured from the server into a simple ceramic mug. A smooth stream. Steam curling upward. Panel 10: Both hands wrapped around the warm mug. Steam rising from the surface. Panel 11: The mug lifted to the lips. Eyes close slightly. Panel 12 (finish): First sip taken. A slow exhale of breath visible as steam. Soft satisfied expression. The whole image should be a pure rough scribbled thumbnail sheet. Messy, crude, no details, no shading, no color, no text.\

prompt_en: Create a hyper-realistic outdoor lifestyle portrait in a dreamy summer film photography style, 3:4 vertical composition. Use the uploaded portrait only as the identity and hairstyle reference. Preserve the person’s facial identity, face shape, natural facial features, skin tone, hairstyle, hair length, hair volume, and general body proportions accurately. Do not copy the original portrait’s clothes, background, lighting, pose, or image quality. The subject is standing on an upper-floor balcony, leaning slightly forward over a dark blue metal railing and looking directly into the camera with a calm, soft, gentle expression. The camera is positioned from a low angle below the balcony, creating a natural upward-looking perspective, as if someone is looking up at the subject from the courtyard. The scene takes place on a bright sunny day outside a quiet residential building. The background includes a pale white exterior wall, a slanted roof edge, clean blue sky, and soft green tree leaves in the foreground. Some leaves should be close to the lens and slightly blurred, creating natural depth and a candid summer atmosphere. The subject wears a simple white summer dress or soft white blouse with a clean youthful look. The styling should feel fresh, natural, and realistic, not overly fashionable or staged. Hair should move slightly in the breeze, with fine hair strands catching the sunlight. Keep the pose relaxed and natural, with one or both hands lightly touching the balcony railing. Lighting should be bright natural daylight with strong backlight from the upper sky, soft lens flare, glowing rim light around the hair, slight overexposure in the highlights, and a warm nostalgic summer feeling. The image should look like a real photograph taken with a vintage digital camera or soft film camera: gentle grain, soft focus, natural skin texture, subtle haze, slightly washed colors, realistic shadows, and no heavy beauty retouching. Make the final image feel like a real-life candid summer portrait, romantic, clean, airy, youthful, and cinematic. No text, no logo, no watermark. Negative Prompt： anime, illustration, cartoon, 3D render, CGI, doll-like face, plastic skin, overly smooth skin, heavy retouching, fake face, distorted face, wrong facial identity, changed hairstyle, changed hair length, extra limbs, deformed hands, broken fingers, unnatural wrist, bad anatomy, strange body proportions, stiff pose,\

prompt_en:
Use a cinematic, Kodak film style with slightly reduced saturation, high dynamic range, and realistic contrast.
Lens: 85mm lens, f/1.8 aperture, shallow depth of field, RAW photo-level realism with rich details.

Generate a cinematic character poster of “Frieren” from Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End.
It should be both a character poster and a reflection of her story.

Use a large, elegant side-profile silhouette of the character’s face occupying half of the frame. Inside it, depict smaller full-body figures and actions with a sense of depth (near large, far small), with a slight ultra-wide lens feeling.

The character’s appearance and clothing must stay true to the original design—intelligent, cool, and refined, with a subtle ink-brush glow. Movements should feel smooth and natural.

Facial features and outfit details should adapt from the original design. She should hold her original weapon, and her expression and pose must match her character personality.

Generate it as a 9:16 poster.\

prompt_en: Create a wide cinematic photograph of a minimalist contemporary installation artwork in a white gallery room. The scene shows dozens of tiny suspended metal, acrylic, wire, and glass fragments hanging from the ceiling by thin vertical strings, carefully arranged in midair like an exploded deconstructed sculpture. Count the visible suspended components as about 45 discrete pieces: thin rods, small rectangular plates, angled strips, circular ring, crossbars, and tiny connector blocks, all in pale silver, clear, and off-white materials. A strong soft spotlight from above and behind projects their combined shadows onto the smooth concrete floor, forming four huge blurred Chinese characters reading 来都来了. The shadow typography should dominate the foreground, oversized and soft-edged, stretching toward the viewer with realistic perspective. The physical hanging fragments should appear abstract and unreadable by themselves, but their shadows clearly align into the text.
